title: DeepSeek发布V4.1-Flash-1017："许愿式编程"让一句话生成完整可玩游戏
summary: DeepSeek推出V4.1-Flash-1017，在"性能—费用帕累托改进"理念下实现速度更快、输出更短、成本更低，并推出"许愿式编程"功能，用户只需描述需求，模型自动完成规划、写代码、运行、检查和修改全流程；同步开放自研Search/Fetch搜索API，每千次请求仅5元，限时至11月1日免费。
summary_en: DeepSeek released V4.1-Flash-1017, featuring "wish-based programming" where users describe a project goal and the model autonomously handles planning, coding, execution, inspection and revision via self-reinforcement learning. The model also opens a self-developed Search and Fetch API at ¥5 per 1,000 successful requests. Benchmarks show improved performance with shorter output and reduced costs across DeepSeek Harness, Tencent CodeBuddy and WorkBuddy frameworks.
